### `kv_cache`

Storage and update of past keys/values (blocks/attention/kv_cache). Chosen by: convert option `cache_impl`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `mutable` (default) | ExecuTorch mutable buffer updated in place (index_copy_). |
| xnnpack | `io_scatter` | Cache as graph input/output, functional index_put. |
| xnnpack | `io_concat` | Cache as graph input/output, where() on a one-hot position mask. |
| qnn | `mutable` (default) | HTP mutable buffer updated in place (index_copy_). |
| qnn | `io_scatter` | Cache as graph input/output, QNN ScatterNd. |
| qnn | `io_concat` | Cache as graph input/output, QNN element-wise select. |
| onnx | `io_inplace` (default) | ONNX TensorScatter (opset 24); consumers may update the buffer in place. |
| onnx | `io_scatter` | ONNX ScatterND. |
| onnx | `io_concat` | ONNX Where on a one-hot position mask. |
| onnx | `io_paged` | Only with a custom translation of tsurgeon::paged_attention (the tensorrt backend provides one). |
| tensorrt | `io_inplace` (default) | TensorScatter executed in place by TensorRT (output aliased to input). |
| tensorrt | `io_scatter` | TensorRT ScatterND. |
| tensorrt | `io_concat` | TensorRT Select. |
| tensorrt | `io_paged` | Paged KV pool of the TensorRT Edge-LLM AttentionPlugin. |

### `attention_kernel`

How attention scores and the weighted sum are computed (blocks/attention/kernels). Chosen by: convert option `attn_impl`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `manual` (default) | MatMul + Softmax + MatMul, delegated to XNNPACK. |
| xnnpack | `sdpa` | aten.scaled_dot_product_attention, decomposed at lowering. |
| xnnpack | `custom_sdpa` | ExecuTorch llama::custom_sdpa + llama::update_cache CPU kernels (scans only the filled cache; needs the mutable cache). |
| qnn | `manual` (default) | HTP MatMul/Softmax/MatMul with grouped heads broadcast (no cache copy). |
| qnn | `sdpa` | aten.scaled_dot_product_attention, decomposed at lowering. |
| onnx | `manual` (default) | ONNX MatMul/Softmax/MatMul. |
| onnx | `sdpa` | Decomposed scaled-dot-product attention. |
| onnx | `paged` | Only with a custom translation of tsurgeon::paged_attention. |
| tensorrt | `manual` (default) | MatMul/Softmax/MatMul; scores are cast to float32 by the fp32_attention_scores pass. |
| tensorrt | `sdpa` | Decomposed scaled-dot-product attention. |
| tensorrt | `paged` | TensorRT Edge-LLM AttentionPlugin (XQA decode kernels). |

### `masked_softmax`

Masking by replacing masked scores instead of adding a penalty (manual kernel only). Chosen by: convert option `masked_softmax`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `False` (default) | Additive mask (-65504 on masked positions). |
| xnnpack | `True` | Masked scores replaced by (row minimum - 20); keeps quantised score ranges tight. |
| qnn | `False` (default) | Additive mask (-65504 on masked positions). |
| qnn | `True` | Masked scores replaced by (row minimum - 20); keeps quantised score ranges tight. |
| onnx | `False` (default) | Additive mask (-65504 on masked positions). |
| onnx | `True` | Masked scores replaced by (row minimum - 20); keeps quantised score ranges tight. |
| tensorrt | `False` (default) | Additive mask (-65504 on masked positions). |
| tensorrt | `True` | Masked scores replaced by (row minimum - 20); keeps quantised score ranges tight. |

### `rmsnorm`

Implementation of RMS normalisation (blocks/norm). Chosen by: convert option `rmsnorm_impl`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `rmsnorm_prescaled` (default) | Max-abs rescale then RMS normalisation (float16-overflow safe). |
| xnnpack | `rmsnorm` | Plain RMS normalisation. |
| xnnpack | `rmsnorm_upcast` | Normalisation computed in float32, cast back. |
| qnn | `rmsnorm_prescaled` (default) | Max-abs rescale then RMS normalisation (float16-overflow safe). |
| qnn | `rmsnorm` | Plain RMS normalisation (fused into one HTP RmsNorm operation). |
| qnn | `rmsnorm_upcast` | Normalisation computed in float32, cast back. |
| onnx | `rmsnorm_prescaled` (default) | Max-abs rescale then RMS normalisation (float16-overflow safe). |
| onnx | `rmsnorm` | Plain RMS normalisation. |
| onnx | `rmsnorm_upcast` | Normalisation computed in float32, cast back. |
| tensorrt | `rmsnorm_prescaled` (default) | Max-abs rescale then RMS normalisation (float16-overflow safe). |
| tensorrt | `rmsnorm` | Plain RMS normalisation. |
| tensorrt | `rmsnorm_upcast` | Normalisation computed in float32, cast back. |

### `linear_quantization`

How quantised compressed linear layers (blocks/layers/linear_compressed.py) are lowered. Chosen by: config field `xnnpack.quant_path`, `qnn.quant_scope`, `tensorrt.int4_backend`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `pt2e` (default) | PT2E quantise/dequantise pairs from a linear-only quantiser; per-tensor or per-channel weights. |
| xnnpack | `torchao` | torchao IntxUnpackedToInt8Tensor weights with dynamic int8 per-token activations (8daXw), dynamically-quantised XNNPACK partitioner; supports per-group scales. |
| qnn | `linear` (default) | Only compressed linears are quantised (W4 -> 16a4w, W8 -> 8a8w); every other operation stays float16. |
| qnn | `all` | Every operation gets 16-bit activations (W4 -> 16a4w, W8 -> 16a8w, float linears -> 16a16w): one HTP partition. |
| onnx | `qdq` (default) | DequantizeLinear on integer weight initialisers (+ QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear for static int8 activations). |
| tensorrt | `dequantize` (default) | DequantizeLinear -> Gemm (no extra dependency). |
| tensorrt | `edgellm_plugin` | TensorRT Edge-LLM Int4GroupwiseGemmPluginV2 for eligible INT4 layers. |

### `linear_lowering`

Operation that carries a linear layer on the device. Chosen by: config field `qnn.convert_linear_to_conv2d`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `fully_connected` (default) | XNNPACK fully-connected. |
| qnn | `False` (default) | QNN FullyConnected. |
| qnn | `True` | 1x1 Conv2d (forced when weights are block-quantised, LPBQ). |
| onnx | `gemm` (default) | ONNX MatMul/Gemm. |
| tensorrt | `gemm` (default) | TensorRT matrix multiply. |

### `mlp`

Feed-forward block (blocks/mlp); the model dictionary picks plain or gated. Chosen by: model dictionary `mlp_type`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `mlp` | Two XNNPACK fully-connected layers with the activation in between. |
| xnnpack | `mlp_gated` | Three XNNPACK fully-connected layers; activation of the gate times the up projection. |
| qnn | `mlp` | Two QNN FullyConnected (or 1x1 Conv2d) operations with the activation in between. |
| qnn | `mlp_gated` | Three QNN FullyConnected (or 1x1 Conv2d) operations; activation of the gate times the up projection. |
| onnx | `mlp` | Two ONNX MatMul/Gemm nodes with the activation in between. |
| onnx | `mlp_gated` | Three ONNX MatMul/Gemm nodes; activation of the gate times the up projection. |
| tensorrt | `mlp` | Two TensorRT matrix multiplies with the activation in between. |
| tensorrt | `mlp_gated` | Three TensorRT matrix multiplies; activation of the gate times the up projection. |

### `rope_frequencies`

Rotary-embedding frequencies (blocks/positions); the model dictionary picks the variant. Chosen by: model dictionary `rope_type`.

| Backend | Option | Device operation |
|---|---|---|
| xnnpack | `default` | Plain cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| xnnpack | `llama3` | Band-scaled cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| qnn | `default` | Plain cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| qnn | `llama3` | Band-scaled cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| onnx | `default` | Plain cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| onnx | `llama3` | Band-scaled cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| tensorrt | `default` | Plain cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |
| tensorrt | `llama3` | Band-scaled cos/sin tables computed at conversion and stored as constants; the rotation is element-wise multiply/add on the device. |

Projection of the last hidden state to the vocabulary (a compressed linear layer). Chosen by: single implementation.

| qnn | `linear` (default) | Same lowering as every other linear layer (see linear_lowering). |
